slides.title: A new client wants your certificate of insurance before Monday's job
You find the PDF in an old email thread...
slides.body: Then you notice the policy dates.

slides.title: It expired last month.
slides.body: Nobody got a reminder. Nobody renewed it.

slides.title: Now it's calls to your agent, a rushed renewal, and a nervous client
slides.body: All because one date slipped through the cracks.

slides.title: Never get caught like this
slides.body: CertTrack tracks your policies, licenses and permits and alerts you before they expire.
